ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) distribution across the central fluke body, with localized high-intensity (white) regions concentrated at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes; estimated 80:20 dark-to-light ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark pigmentation block centered on the main fluke body. Left distal tip contains a white patch with multiple horizontal dark bands. Right distal tip contains a white patch containing two distinct dark circular spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 130 degrees and moderate depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations with multiple sharp triangular peaks and valleys along the entire linear boundary from left to right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve following the trailing edge, tapering to irregular, jagged distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct circular dark-on-white rings located on the distal right lobe; irregular clusters of small white-on-black spots visible at the extreme outer edges of both tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of four parallel horizontal dark linear marks (rake markings) visible on the high-intensity white patch of the left distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular jaggedness and physical erosion at both distal lobe tips, consistent with significant mechanical trauma or barnacle colonization history.
